timeline.summary: On April 23, 2026, Star Cement announced that its subsidiary SCNEL acquired 100% of Jaitaran Renewable Power Private Limited for ₹20,000.

Prem Kumar Bhajanka and persons acting in concert (including Yash Bala Bhajanka, Nancy Choudhary, Tushar Bhajanka) disclosed no new encumbrances in Star Cement Limited under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of 03.04.2026.
Rajesh Kumar Agarwal and persons acting in concert (Annexure A) disclosed no new encumbrances in Star Cement Limited under SEBI’s Takeover Regulations, 2011, as of 03.04.2026.

Sanjay Agarwal and persons acting in concert (including Divya Agarwal, Auroville Investments Pvt. Ltd., Sumangal International Pvt. Ltd., Sumangal Business Pvt. Ltd.) disclosed no new encumbrances in Star Cement Limited as of 03.04.2026.
Sajjan Bhajanka, as Promoter, confirmed no new encumbrances on Star Cement shares beyond those disclosed in FY2025-26 via SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) disclosure.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,173.55 Cr (+11.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹148.1 Cr (+20.2% YoY).
Star Cement Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on 26 May 2026 via its website.
Star Cement reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,174 Cr and PAT of ₹147 Cr, guiding for 10-12% volume growth in FY27.
Star Cement released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation outlining a capacity expansion roadmap to 16.7 MTPA by FY29.
